contract.definition: u: User = User.allInstances()->any(x: User | x.UserID = uid), c: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(x: BookCopy | x.Barcode = barcode), r: Reserve = Reserve.allInstances()->any(x: Reserve | x.ReservedUser = u and x.ReservedCopy = c and x.IsReserveClosed = false)
contract.precondition: User.allInstances()->exists(x: User | x.UserID = uid) and BookCopy.allInstances()->exists(x: BookCopy | x.Barcode = barcode) and c.Status = "LOANED" and c.IsReserved = true and Reserve.allInstances()->exists(x: Reserve | x.ReservedUser = u and x.ReservedCopy = c and x.IsReserveClosed = false)
contract.postcondition: c.IsReserved = false and r.IsReserveClosed = true and result = true
